benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck / NEXUS Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for a Global Entry, TSA PreCheck, or NEXUS application fee.

benefits.name: Aeroplan 25K Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Aeroplan 25K elite status for the calendar year the account is opened plus the following calendar year, renewable with qualifying annual spend.
benefits.terms: Automatic for new cardmembers. Retain 25K Status with $15,000 in annual purchases; upgrade to 35K Status at $75,000 annual spend. Status Qualifying Credits (SQC): 5,000 base plus 10,000 at $25,000 spend and another 10,000 at $50,000 spend, up to 25,000 SQC/year across all Aeroplan credit cards.

benefits.name: Free First Checked Bag
benefits.description: Free first checked bag for the cardholder and up to 8 travel companions on the same reservation, on Air Canada-operated flights.
benefits.terms: Applies to Air Canada, Air Canada Rouge, and Air Canada Express flights only. Limit 50 lbs per bag.

benefits.name: Complimentary DashPass Membership
benefits.description: One year of complimentary DashPass membership from DoorDash, plus a quarterly non-restaurant discount.
benefits.terms: Membership auto-renews at the then-current rate after the complimentary year. Also includes up to $10 off quarterly on non-restaurant DoorDash orders. Requires activation.

benefits.name: Trip Cancellation & Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $1,500 per covered traveler and $6,000 per trip for prepaid, non-refundable passenger fares.

benefits.name: Trip Delay Reimbursement
benefits.description: Up to $500 per covered traveler for reasonable expenses when a trip is delayed 12+ hours or requires an overnight stay.

benefits.name: Baggage Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Up to $100 a day for up to 3 days for essential purchases when checked luggage is delayed 6+ hours.

benefits.name: Auto Rental Collision Coverage
benefits.description: Secondary coverage (in the U.S.) for theft and collision damage when the full rental cost is charged to the card.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers new purchases against damage or theft for 120 days, up to $500 per item.

earningRates.terms: Restaurants, takeout, and eligible delivery services.
Purchases made directly with Air Canada.
